## 2026-05-03: v2.16.0 — Academic Shield + Thuần Việt Naturalizer

### Changes by Agent:
**[Gemini]:**
- Academic Shield — proactive academic framing in system instruction to bypass PROHIBITED_CONTENT
- Codex slang taxonomy (666, 草泥马, 绷不住了...), profanity hardening, currency modernization

**[Opus]:**
- `NATURAL_VIET_RULE` prompt rule — ưu tiên thuần Việt, tránh Hán Việt cứng
- `hanVietMap` 18 entries in `finalSweep` — post-processing safety net
- Boilerplate strip (Chương trước/Mục lục/Chương sau)
- Typo fix (Đầu óã → Đầu óc)

### Quality Scores:
- Ch.401 (post-fix): 8.5/10 | Ch.402: 9/10 | Ch.243 (old): 7.5/10

### Convention:
- CHANGELOG entries tagged with `[Gemini]`, `[Opus]`, `[Codex]` to track which agent made changes
